create_oxford_pets_dataset: create an Oxford Pets classification dataset from raw images and annotations into VISSL-compatible format
download_oxford_pets_dataset: download and extract the Oxford Pets dataset images and annotations archives
create_oxford_pets_split: create a train or test split of Oxford Pets images organized by label into output folders
extract_oxford_pets_label: extract the pet breed label from an Oxford Pets image filename
run_oxford_pets_script: run the Oxford Pets data preparation script with input, output, and download arguments
